# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- The user dislikes full-row color styling in MudBlazor tables and prefers using status chips/badges (MudChip) within specific cells to indicate status (e.g., match results).
The user wants 'Black' results to use Color.Dark MudChips.
The user wants 'Green' results to use Color.Success MudChips.
The user wants 'Remis' results to use Color.Default MudChips.
